Value proposition

ASESORA doesn’t produce polished reports: it produces judgment.

Each deliverable answers a concrete question an investor or executive needs to resolve before committing capital or time. The service combines technical construction and project analysis with business vision and basic financial structuring.

The differentiator versus a generalist consultancy: the advisor has executed projects between €0.5M and €15M in CAPEX, knows the gap between paper and site, and has sat on real investment committees.

Frequently asked questions

How does ASESORA differ from a generalist consultancy?

The advisor has executed projects between €0.5M and €15M in CAPEX, knows the gap between paper and site, and has sat on real investment committees. Each deliverable answers a concrete question to resolve before committing capital or time.

What engagement formats are available?

Monthly retainer (10–15 h/month, 3-month minimum renewable quarterly) or a scoped project of 2 to 8 weeks depending on scope, with kick-off, analysis, final deliverable and presentation session.

What do I receive in an investment advisory project?

A strategic document, scenario modeling, a risk matrix and an executive presentation. Typical cases: new-asset business case, techno-economic feasibility, risk report, CAPEX and schedule for committee, and SPV structuring.

How much does it cost and how long does it take?

Quotes are custom, after an initial no-commitment consultation. The contract sets scope and deliverables before kick-off. Typical cycle: 4–8 weeks.

Have a decision on the table?

Contract with scope and deliverables defined before kick-off. Typical cycle: 4–8 weeks.
